create_BertConfig: create a BertConfig instance from a JSON file or vocabulary size to configure BERT model parameters
build_BertModel: build a BERT encoder model with embeddings, attention layers, and optional pooler for sequence encoding
run_BertForPreTraining: run BERT pre-training with masked language modeling and next sentence prediction loss computation
build_BertHF: build a Fairseq-integrated BERT model registered as bert_hf for fairseq language model training
load_pretrained_BertModel: load a pretrained BERT model from a config JSON and PyTorch state dict with weight initialization
